name: Huilong
introduce:
DMS-000 辉龙
由温斯顿博士设计，拉尼亚凯亚制造的重型机兵。该机整合了全钢岚合金框架、机械与脑波复合驱动系统等新技术，拥有优秀的基础性能。在受到异世界龙神加护之后，它的外形和操作模式发生了进一步变化。

30488.name: Dragon's Might - Unfettered
30488.SpecificEffects: Ignores unit obstruction when moving. When [Wataru] pilots the complete [Huilong], movement <color=#F74848>+1</color> and movement type changes to hovering, allowing this unit to pass over low obstacle.

30482.name: Dragon's Might - Enlightenment
30482.SpecificEffects: Increases DMG dealt by allies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles by <color=#F74848>3%</color>. If piloted by [Wataru], this effect is doubled.

30486.name: Dragon's Might - Rising Wind
30486.SpecificEffects: Shield cannot be equipped on right arm. When equipping other melee weapons, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>. This effect is doubled against bosses.

30484.name: Dragon's Might - Guard
30484.SpecificEffects: When a Shield is equipped on left arm, DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>5%</color>. This effect is doubled against bosses.

20574.name: Valor Core
20574.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. This effect is doubled against bosses.

30478.name: Radiance Mod
30478.SpecificEffects:
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> AP currently possesses, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>24%</color>.
When initiating combat with a skill costing <color=#F74848>6</color> AP or more, this attack cannot be dodged, <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf> or <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> against, and will always score a critical hit.
